A week in Queenstown over New Year. They flew into Christchurch on 28 December
2019, drove down, and came home on 4 January 2020.

This note exists to pin the one span that crosses a year boundary: a photograph
from 30 December and one from 2 January belong to the same trip and must be
captioned with their OWN years, not the trip's start year.
